header: The people who decide the roadmap
subheadline: Three maintainers at webconsulting studio decide what goes into each Desiderio release.

members.name: Sofia Berg
members.title: Project Lead
members.bio: Has led every release since 1.0, including the move to 244 content elements and theme presets per page.

members.name: Noah Ritter
members.title: Accessibility Lead
members.bio: Reviews focus states, ARIA attributes and screen-reader text before any element ships.

members.name: Lea Fischer
members.title: Quality Lead
members.bio: Runs the automated template audit and the PHPStan level 8 check that every pull request must pass.
